description: This file defines a router for booking-related API endpoints using tRPC, including procedures for getting, updating, and reporting bookings, with various input schemas and external handler imports.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles fetching booking data with authentication.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Handles editing booking location with authentication.

methods.name: addGuests
methods.description: Handles adding guests to a booking with authentication.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles confirming a booking with authentication.

methods.name: getBookingDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed booking info with authentication.

methods.name: getInstantBookingLocation
methods.description: Public endpoint to get instant booking location.

methods.name: reportBooking
methods.description: Reports a booking issue with authentication.

methods.name: reportWrongAssignment
methods.description: Reports wrong assignment issue with authentication.

methods.name: hasWrongAssignmentReport
methods.description: Checks for existing wrong assignment reports with authentication.

methods.name: getRoutingTrace
methods.description: Fetches routing trace info with authentication.

methods.name: getWrongAssignmentReports
methods.description: Fetches wrong assignment reports with team-based access control.

methods.name: updateWrongAssignmentReportStatus
methods.description: Updates status of wrong assignment reports with authentication.
